This 10-second explainer will get you started: Your car will start in 1st gear. At the start of your turn, your first decision is whether to stay on your current gear, or go up 1 gear or go down 1 gear. You can go down 1 gear without penalty, or "skip" up to 3 gears at the cost of wear points. You may only go up by 1 gear per turn. After choosing a gear, you will roll the appropriate "gear die". The higher the gear, the bigger the die, as well as the farther you go. Once you have rolled, you must move the number of spaces rolled, although you may choose which lane you take. [Rating: 1/10] I really didn't like this game. The genre as a whole is unappealing but this one seems love it or hate it.

[Rating: 1/10] Choose a gear (which one is painfully obvious), roll the dice, move the car.  Seriously, a roll and move game....  Try Championship Formula Racing instead.  If you can't get a copy of CFR, then Speed Circuit is the forerunner, but CFR is better.

[Rating: 1/10] Our first and last game with 6 friends: Boring.I ask myself the question whether an editor has tested the game at all! Never again!!!

[Rating: 1/10] Everything about this felt unnecessary. The shifting creates a thematic tie, but between that and the damage it just makes a “race” game feel so SLOW. Downforce is what this should have been.

[Rating: 1/10] Oh boy, I fall asleep when NASCAR is on, and well I nearly fell asleep at this dice car race mess. Probably would of loved it as a kid. Well I would of at least loved the map as a kid. Even the game of life has more substance.

[Rating: 1/10] Non-Sensik ,apart videogames do it better, why bring dice=Ramdomness in the kingdom of skill and ability( aka F1)?

[Rating: 1/10] Drags on for too long for a push-your-luck game. Too much luck for a long game. I would tolerate it more if the game is way shorter. Even the one-lap mode is a bit too long. Lacks the charm of Diamant, which is a more rowdy and funny game. Lacks the cleverness of Rallyman: GT.  It sucks with more players. Downtime is awful and it should be avoided like the plague.

[Rating: 1/10] I tried to total my car by the third round. If I play this game, I try to die as soon as possible so I can leave.

[Rating: 1/10] This might genuinely be the worst game I've ever played. 100% luck based, no strategy at all, and absolutely no fun if you don't get lucky in the first three rounds.

[Rating: 1/10] One of the worst thing that happened to board games are games: "roll 4 and move 4 spots". As a kid I thought that all board games are like that, so I wasn't interested in them at all.  This game takes this stupid idea, makes it 5 times more complex and adds totally ridiculous and unnecessary rules.  The game is so freaking random, unfair and without any ability to catch up after bad rolls, that it is barely a game.  Totally awful experience.
